request: Please find me data regarding first-of-class ship cost overruns

reply.reply:
**GAO estimated Columbia lead-boat costs could exceed Navy plans by hundreds of millions; the Constellation lead ship carries design costs and its builder reported over 10% weight growth.**

- In October 2023 the FFG-62 builder reported unplanned design weight growth exceeding 10 percent over its June 2020 estimate, suggesting possible cost growth. (R44972, PDF p. 39)
- GAO estimated from data through May 2023 that Columbia lead-submarine construction costs could exceed Navy planned costs by hundreds of millions of dollars. (R41129, PDF p. 17)
- The FY2026 Navy budget places CVN-79 delivery 54 months later than its FY2013 budget estimate. (RS20643, PDF p. 15)
reply.reasoning: Recent CRS reports summarize GAO’s Columbia lead-boat cost risk and document Constellation lead-ship costs and weight-growth concerns. The Ford-class finding concerns delivery delay, not a quantified cost overrun.
